title: Atomic image with an id-only image-src (the preferred media-library form, R9 XOR honored)
_comment: WP-Q01 VALID fixture (one-per-atomic-widget, SUPPLEMENT §B.2 e-image; Detailed-Req #1). The `image` OBJECT envelope ([R8]) carries src:image-src with id ONLY (the preferred media-library form — sideload first; never id AND url, never neither, R9/§3.2 image-src-prop-type.php:36-44) plus size 'full'. attachment id 1 exists on the dev site. VERIFIED valid:true via Validator::dry_run on Elementor 4.1.1. prefilter.verdict:defer — image/image-src are not trivially-proven (the pre-filter does enforce R9 XOR structurally but defers the rest, §4).
